population.note: Kyrenia district has been outside the effective control of the Government of the Republic of Cyprus since 1974, and the Republic's censuses since then have not counted it. The census taken on 4 December 2011 by the Turkish Cypriot administration in the north of Cyprus (not recognised internationally) counts the north's residents by quarter (mahalle), and its quarters are bound to 31 of this district's 46 community polygons, which hold 51,980 of the 69,163 residents it counts in the district. The other 15 (Agios Amvrosios Keryneias, Agirda, Belapais, Ftericha, Karmi, Kato Dikomo, Kazafani, Motides, Myrtou, Palaiosofos, Panagra, Pano Dikomo, Templos, Thermeia, Trapeza) carry none of its counts, each saying why, so no sum of the district's villages is its population, and that census's figures for its own districts (ilçe) are not put on the Republic's.
